_comment: Illustrative growth assumptions (per year, compounding from the base year), not an official forecast. Calibrate against the CEC 2025 IEPR demand forecast by adding "calibration_csv" to a scenario (see scenarios.py). data_center_mw: new data-center peak load by 5-digit county FIPS, modeled flat at peak x data_center_load_factor.

low.note: Slow electrification, efficiency keeps pace, no new data centers

mid.note: Steady EV/heat-pump adoption; a 1 GW AI campus in Kern (the Griddy demo site) and 500 MW in Santa Clara

high.note: Fast electrification and an AI data-center build-out in Kern, Santa Clara, Fresno and Imperial
